# Implementation Plan: Vehicle Management

**Branch**: `001-vehicle-management` | **Date**: 2026-06-08 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-vehicle-management/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit-plan` command. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

## Summary

Implement full CRUD Vehicle Management for the PrioraScan workshop platform. The feature enables technicians, service advisors, and workshop managers to create, view, search, and edit vehicle records within their organization. All operations enforce multi-tenant isolation, RBAC permissions, and synchronous audit logging. The vehicle detail page includes a forward-compatible History placeholder for future Diagnostic Session linking.

**Technical approach**: NestJS backend with PostgreSQL (Prisma ORM), Next.js frontend (TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query), JWT authentication in HTTP-only cookies, double-submit CSRF protection, permission-based RBAC.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5.x

**Primary Dependencies**:
- Backend: NestJS 10+, Prisma 5+, class-validator, class-transformer, Jest, Supertest
- Frontend: Next.js 14+, React 18+, TailwindCSS, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Axios

**Storage**: PostgreSQL 15+ (S3/R2 reserved for future file attachments)

**Testing**:
- Backend: Jest (unit, integration, contract, security)
- Frontend: Jest + React Testing Library (unit, integration, security), Playwright (E2E)

**Target Platform**: Web application (workshop desktop/tablet), Linux/VPS/cloud server deployment

**Project Type**: Web application (backend + frontend monorepo)

**Performance Goals**:
- Vehicle list queries < 500ms for up to 10,000 vehicles per organization
- Audit record generation < 100ms synchronous with mutation
- Frontend dashboard load < 3 seconds

**Constraints**:
- No vehicle deletion in MVP (future Administration feature)
- No hard uniqueness constraints on VIN/Plate Number in MVP (warning only)
- Audit records must be immutable and tenant-scoped
- No cross-tenant data leakage under any error condition

**Scale/Scope**: Single-organization vehicle count up to 10,000 in MVP. Horizontal API scaling supported via stateless JWT + PostgreSQL.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design.*

### Pre-Design Gate

| Principle | Status | Evidence |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| I. Documentation First | ✅ | PRD, SAD, Frontend Architecture exist and are referenced |
| II. Design Before Implementation | ✅ | Feature spec exists; this plan is the design artifact |
| IV. Modular Development | ✅ | Vehicle Management is isolated; no Diagnostic Sessions dependency except placeholder UI |
| VI. Multi-Tenant First | ✅ | Every entity carries `organizationId`; all queries scoped |
| VII. API First | ✅ | All capabilities exposed via REST API; frontend consumes API only |
| XI. Auditability | ✅ | `VehicleAuditRecord` created synchronously on every mutation |
| XII. Security By Default | ✅ | JWT auth, RBAC, tenant isolation, CSRF protection, secure cookies |
| XIV. Git & Change Safety | ✅ | Feature branch `001-vehicle-management`; main is protected |
| XV. Simplicity Over Complexity | ✅ | No delete, no DMS features, no PrioraFlow dependency |
| XVI. Backend-Centric Business Logic | ✅ | All validation, RBAC, tenant isolation, audit in backend |

### Post-Design Gate (Re-evaluated)

| Check | Status | Justification |
|-------|--------|---------------|
| Feature does not contradict PRD, SAD, or Frontend Architecture | ✅ | Vehicle Management is explicitly in PRD Section 6; SAD defines Vehicle entity and UC-01; Frontend Architecture defines `/vehicles` routes and components |
| Multi-tenant boundaries defined for all new entities | ✅ | `Vehicle` and `VehicleAuditRecord` both require `organizationId`; repository layer enforces scoping; no cross-tenant queries |
| API contracts specified before backend implementation | ✅ | `contracts/vehicle-api.yaml` and `contracts/vehicle-api-errors.yaml` define endpoints, schemas, and error codes |
| AI features include explainability and human-confirmation | N/A | No AI in Vehicle Management scope |
| No PrioraFlow dependency introduced for core workflows | ✅ | Vehicle CRUD operates standalone; no integration endpoints used |
| Error handling and audit logging included in design | ✅ | Error contract documents all status codes and codes; audit schema covers create and update actions |

**Gate Result**: ✅ PASSED. All constitutional requirements are satisfied. No violations require justification.
